checkpoints.title: Bounded tokenization before precedence parsing
checkpoints.contract: Tokenize at most 1024 UTF-8 source bytes into at most 64 tokens: nonnegative decimal i64 literals, plus, star and ASCII whitespace. Keep byte spans; reject unknown symbols and out-of-range literals. This stage does not parse precedence, unary signs or parentheses, or evaluate expressions.

checkpoints.title: Complete current reference
checkpoints.contract: The complete documented reference contract, including later project features. This is explicitly the final checkpoint, not an earlier milestone.
